# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_3_4_DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** Structural DTE/hold finding  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE of the vwap_continuation signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) from 0-2 DTE to 3 and 4 DTE will continue to show increasing OOS expectancy per trade due to lower theta decay on entry, without increasing gap risk (since the -8% stop keeps held% near 0). We expect the OOS exp/tr to be monotonic increasing: 0DTE < 1DTE < 2DTE < 3DTE < 4DTE.

## Mechanism

Same as the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate: trigger on the vwap_continuation signal (first qualifying morning bar ≤10:30 ET that continues in-trend), enter at next bar open, same strike (ITM-2), same exit (-8%/+30%), but now we consider options with 3 and 4 days to expiration. We will run the backtest on the newly backfilled options_3dte/4dte OPRA data.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ for 0DTE ITM-2; for 3-4 DTE ITM-2 premium is higher (~2.5-3.5× 0DTE based on term structure), so same $25K account supports ~8-11 contracts (vs 28 at 0DTE). Paper $1K scales to ~14% headline at 0DTE, ~4-5% at 3-4 DTE.
2. **Sample bias:** Using same vwap_continuation signal and trigger logic; sample size for 3-4 DTE will be smaller than 0-2 DTE due to fewer available DTE buckets in backfill (~1/7th frequency). Overfit risk low as no signal/parameter changes, only DTE extension.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run walk-forward held-out window once 3-4 DTE backfill is available)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate top 3 J days via realistic OPRA simulation once backfill is available)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Overnight gap >8% against position (stop may slip, losing >50% premium)
   - Max drawdown: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
   - Blow-up scenario: Consecutive losing trades in choppy market combined with higher dollar risk per contract (longer DTE premium) could exceed daily loss limit
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top-5 days % of P&L once backtest is complete)
